Included because QAPEK-OH is the final membrane with reported material properties: the manuscript states that the measured water uptake and IEC were 16.67% and 0.41 mequiv. g−1, respectively, and discusses anion conductivity. Figure 3/text describe conversion of CMPEK to QAPEK by immersing the CMPEK membrane in 35 wt% triethylamine aqueous solution at room temperature for 48 h, followed by exchange in 1 M KOH at room temperature for 48 h to obtain QAPEK-OH. Figure 5/text report FT-IR evidence for QA groups with bands at 3290 and 2359 cm−1 and methylene bands at 2873 and 2968 cm−1. The BPA/DHBP repeat-unit fractions are inherited from the PEK feed composition, x = 0.75 and 1−x = 0.25. The SMILES encodes the covalently attached benzyl triethylammonium groups on the BPA-containing repeat unit; hydroxide counterions are noted from the OH-form sample name and KOH exchange but are not listed as free additives. The exact experimental quaternization/substitution degree was not numerically reported.

"Included because QPPO-SC4 has new membrane-property data in Tables 1–4: IEC, water uptake, linear expansion, hydroxide conductivity, methanol permeability/selectivity, and mechanical properties. Figure 1 and text describe BPPO bromination followed by Wittig reaction with 4-(4-bromobutoxy)benzaldehyde and quaternization with trimethylamine; final membranes are designated QPPO-SC4, QPPO-SC6 and QPPO-SC10 and converted to OH− form. BPPO degree of benzyl bromination from 1H NMR is 33%, so unmodified PPO repeat units are taken as 0.67 and side-chain-modified repeat units as 0.33. Table 1 gives theoretical IEC 1.52 mmol/g and elemental-analysis IEC 0.84 mmol/g; using experimental/theoretical IEC = 0.84/1.52 = 0.553 gives quaternized fraction 0.33*0.553 = 0.182 and residual bromoalkyl side-chain fraction 0.33*(1−0.553) = 0.148. Text states measured IEC indicates about 50% of pendant-chain bromide groups are quaternized. The OH− counterion is not encoded as a covalent polymer component."

"Included because QPPO-SC6 has new membrane-property data in Tables 1–4. Text notes the measured IEC values indicate about 50% quaternization of pendant-chain bromides.
